text:
laura: Helix Systems (acct 1199) replied to our overdue notice for INV-2026-089. they say their procurement card was charged twice for the month-end levy and want us to pause collections while they investigate and to avoid chargebacks. attached a one-line screenshot.

ryan: can you paste the exact invoice lines theyre disputing? i'll pull the payment and posting ledger.

laura: pasted snippet:

```
INV-2026-089
Date: 2026-07-18
Total: $4,860.00
1) Platform subs: $2,500.00
2) Usage: $1,860.00
3) Late fee: $500.00
```

collections-bot: automated: dunning reminder sent to billing@helixsys.com for INV-2026-089 on 2026-07-25 08:04 UTC.

meera: pulled payments: i see card payment px_3321 settled on 2026-07-20 for $4,860, and another settlement px_3321-dup posted on 2026-07-21 for $4,860. looks like gateway replayed and we posted two receipts.

ryan: yep duplicate settlement. recommend voiding the duplicate receipt, issuing credit memo CM-2026-062 for $4,860, and marking invoice as paid to avoid chargeback risk. collections: pause any escalation and waive late fee.

laura: cautious note: for card chargebacks we need legal and payments ops looped if customer disputes with issuing bank. Helix warned they'll open a chargeback if we don't resolve within 5 business days. let's act fast.

meera: creating credit memo CM-2026-062 and reversing receipt rr_7784-dup now. regenerating invoice INV-2026-089-R1 showing $0 balance. linking ticket ZD-4889.

collections-bot: automated: collections workflow paused for INV-2026-089 by collections (laura) at 2026-07-25 09:10 UTC.

helix.billing (via email paste): appreciate quick reply. procurement confirms they saw two charges on their card and asked us to confirm refund posting. can you also provide a settlement reference for our card team?

ryan: reply drafted: we reversed the duplicate settlement and issued CM-2026-062 for $4,860. INV-2026-089-R1 now shows zero balance. settlement reversal ref rr_7784-dup and refund posted to card px_3321-rev. attached proof of reversal and credit memo. we've paused any collections notices and waived the late fee for this cycle. please confirm once you see the refund with your bank. cc'ing payments-ops.

laura: payments-ops note: watch for chargeback notifications for px_3321 in case bank processes before reversal clears; if chargeback appears, route to payments-ops and legal with ZD-4889.

meera: logged ENG-9472 to add idempotency checks for gateway settlement webhook (replay protection). assigned to eng-payments with replication steps.

laura: calendar follow-up set for 2026-07-30 to confirm refund cleared. if Helix still reports a chargeback escalate to legal.

ryan: closing action: mark invoice as resolved, add notes in AR ledger, update account record to avoid further automated reminders. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
